festival.title: El Paso Parish Prepares a Lebanese Festival Weekend
festival.body: Saint Sharbel Maronite Catholic Mission in El Paso will host its Lebanese Festival on October 3 and 4. The parish lists Lebanese food, live entertainment and dabke dancing, with Saturday hours of 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. and Sunday hours of noon to 6 p.m., local time. The address is 851 Thorn Avenue, El Paso, Texas. The parish lists admission at $5 per person, with children 12 and under admitted free. Check the parish announcement before traveling for any changes.
festival.source: Parish announcement: Saint Sharbel Maronite Catholic Mission
anniversary.title: Emmitsburg Celebrates Nine Years of Saint Sharbel's Shrine
anniversary.body: The Family of Saint Sharbel USA reports that pilgrims gathered on September 26 at the National Shrine Grotto of Our Lady of Lourdes in Emmitsburg, Maryland, for the ninth anniversary of Saint Sharbel's shrine dedication. The celebration included Eucharistic Adoration, confessions and Mass celebrated by Father Theodore Trinko, IVE, at St. Mary's Glass Chapel. After Mass, pilgrims followed the saint's relic in procession to the shrine, where they received a blessing with Saint Sharbel's oil and venerated the relic. The organizer published its account on September 30.
anniversary.source: Family of Saint Sharbel USA: anniversary account (September 30, 2026)
